messages:
maria-peopleops: FYI new intern (India) starts Mon. Remote, IST. Need plan: I-9/alt verification, BG intake, benefits eligibility, laptop shipping, and IST-friendly orientation. @taro @eli-hr

Taro: Hiring manager. Candidate is student contractor, no SSN, needs code access for shadowing day 1.

eli-hr: Policy: non-US remote = no US I-9. Options: local payroll (if entity) or contractor with W-8BEN/local tax docs. Not eligible for US benefits unless local program exists.

maria-peopleops: We'll onboard as contractor unless payroll confirms. @onboard-bot please send BG consent and vendor kickoff. Also need laptop ETA and a buddy in IST.

onboard-bot: Consent link sent (2025-11-12T08:05Z). Vendor: Checkr International. Candidate prompted for local phone and ID scan.

dev-ops: We can ship via DHL Express to Bangalore. ETA 3-5 biz days after label. Machine will be imaged and VPN/prod certs disabled until BG clears. Need shipping address.

tara-dev: I can buddy. Propose two 30-min overlap slots Wed/Thu 11:30-12:00 IST. I'll prep a short Day-1 checklist and a 15-min prerecorded intro.

eli-hr: India BG usually 7-10 business days for checks if verification needed. Recommend gating prod creds until cleared; provide limited dev access and sanitized data for initial tasks.

Taro: Add onboarding flag to restrict secrets and prod services until BG == cleared. Also confirm contractor agreement and invoice cadence.

maria-peopleops: Action items: (1) @onboard-bot: consent + BG kick (done), (2) @dev-ops: create shipping label once address provided, lock VPN/prod until cleared, (3) @tara-dev: buddy slots + prerecord, (4) @eli-hr: send contractor tax/KYC and agreement template. Will post APAC benefits Q&A link.

Taro: Candidate confirmed DHL address and asked for optional "watch-before-1:1" recording.

maria-peopleops: I'll upload recording, send calendar invites for IST buddy slots, and note to reassess payroll vs contractor if engagement >3 months. :thumbsup:
